test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 3 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Two different positions of the same dice are shown, the six faces of which are numbered from 1 to 6. Select the number that will be on the face opposite to the one showing '2'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f1004c53e0a083c1487111b32e85f3341efd19a4215d1359c9438529c466f564.png]
solution:
Here, we have two dices given and have face 2 has common in both.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a80813d9ccb5decd0abd5a00dbda801741ee46adb1af412c07b5259a017bb8dd.png] 

Since, we can see all the numbers in both the dice except number 6. 

We will start writing the numbers starting from the common number 2, in clockwise direction as:

For 1st dice: 2 - 5 - 1

For 2nd dice: 2 - 4 - 3

So, we see that the number 6 has the opposite of number 2.

Hence, the number __**6**__ will be on the face opposite to the one showing '2'.
